about: Kernel time per phase for each scored shape, one call per shape. Ours: the official kernel profile of the submitted code (one eager call per shape, taken with the 2.13x official run; the profile lists the largest kernels by name and the rest only as a count, which is filed under other). SGLang: a per-kernel profile of the reference on the same shapes and routing (mean of 6 profiled calls). Times in us. A PDL dependent or a side-stream kernel includes its wait, so a shape's kernels sum to more than its GPU busy time.

phase_rule.routed experts: the expert GEMMs and their activation (SGLang: two Marlin MoE GEMMs and act_and_mul; ours: one fused expert kernel)
phase_rule.attention: QK-norm, RoPE, KV-cache write and FP8 casts, the attention kernels, split combine and output norm-gate
phase_rule.dense GEMMs: every cuBLAS, CUTLASS or QuACK GEMM (qkv, o, pooler, router, unpooler) and split-K reduces
phase_rule.other: everything else: layer-boundary norms and residuals, routing, token order, the weighted sum, casts and copies
